summary: Bio Green Med Solution, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that on October 15, 2026 its board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.15 per share on its 6% Convertible Exchangeable Preferred Stock, payable November 1, 2026 to holders of record at the close of business October 26, 2026. No advisor, board recommendation, transaction, stake, or change of control is involved; this is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. The only watch item is the upcoming record and payment dates for preferred holders.
